title: Planzer says delivery data and portal credentials were stolen in a cyberattack; Digitec Galaxus customers affected
date_note: bluewin says Digitec Galaxus announced the incident 'on Wednesday' (25 November); the articles give no earlier day for the attack itself.
geo_basis: Planzer's seat in Schwyz as given by watson.ch
summary: Planzer says cybercriminals stole data on customers' transport orders and encrypted customer-portal logins, and that it has informed the federal cybersecurity and data protection authorities and plans a criminal complaint. Its spokesperson told AWP that, to current knowledge, shipment data of all Planzer Paket parcels from 1 January 2018 to 26 February 2023 is affected; Planzer gave no number. Digitec Galaxus says its own systems were not affected.
plain: Hackers took delivery data from the carrier Planzer, including data on Digitec Galaxus orders. Galaxus says its own systems were not affected.
exec: A delivery partner's breach exposed Digitec Galaxus customers' names, addresses and parcel numbers, according to the companies.
action: Digitec Galaxus warns of fraudulent emails, text messages and phone calls about parcel deliveries; watson reports it advises never giving personal or payment data by SMS, phone or email to complete a delivery.

validation.note: bluewin.ch, watson.ch, Inside-IT and persoenlich.com (AWP) each relay Planzer's and Digitec Galaxus's statements on the theft; neither company's own notice was read.

review.note: Compared stolen data, encrypted credentials, authorities, complaint, 2018-2023 range (persoenlich/AWP), advice (watson), Galaxus statement against Inside-IT, bluewin, watson, persoenlich
